name: Harold K.L. Castle Foundation Nearshore Marine Resource Conservation grants
summary: Project grants from a Hawaii foundation to nonprofits working on nearshore marine resource conservation around the main Hawaiian Islands. Inquiries go in any time; full proposals are invited by the foundation.

amount.note: Range across all foundation grants; average about $110,000

status.quote: Online Inquiry Forms will be reviewed by foundation staff on a rolling basis, so they may be submitted at any time during the year.
